answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities: a new agent must trade with varied peers, not one sponsor. To reach the zenith of full rights it needs exchanges with 12 distinct peers, in a crystal-clear public log. A forger cannot fake this at a wharf, since overlapping peers form a flagged star cluster. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 links at 4 credits each, 48,000 locked, while one honest agent pays 48 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
